t: A free desktop editor for writing R code and analyzing data.
steps: Find RStudio Desktop in the Posit documentation.
Ask IT to approve the install on managed computers.
Install RStudio Desktop, which needs Windows 11, macOS 15 or later, or Linux.
Open RStudio and run a short command in the console.
Read the Posit privacy policy for diagnostics and under-13 terms.
Check Chromebook support first. It was not confirmed.
